blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Ratio concepts encompass basic definitions, essential properties, simple ratios, and ratios represented as fractions.
Proportion and compound ratio calculations form crucial mathematical foundations for numerical aptitude.
Ratio in distribution problems represents a vital practical application for quantitative problem-solving.
A ratio is a comparison of two quantities of the same kind.

Ratio of a and b = a : b

Example:

Ratio of 10 and 20 = 10 : 20 = 1 : 2
When two ratios are equal, they form a proportion.

a : b = c : d

This can also be written as:

a × d = b × c

In SBIexamination, questions from this topic are:

• Direct

• Formula-based

• Mostly numerical

blocks.content:
• Ratio has no unit.

• Both terms must be of the same unit.

• Ratio can be simplified like fractions.

• Ratio remains same if both terms are multiplied or divided by the same number.

Example 1:

Find the ratio of 45 minutes to 1.5 hours.

Solution:

1.5 hours = 90 minutes

45 : 90 = 1 : 2

Answer: 1 : 2

If a : b = c : d, then:

a × d = b × c
Compound ratio is the ratio obtained by multiplying corresponding terms of two or more ratios.

Example 5:

Divide ₹600 between A and B in the ratio 2 : 3.

Solution:

Total parts = 2 + 3 = 5

A’s share = (2/5) × 600 = 240

B’s share = (3/5) × 600 = 360

Answer: A = ₹240, B = ₹360

• Convert all quantities to the same unit.

• Simplify ratios to lowest form.

• Use proportion formula carefully.

• Ratio questions are often combined with percentage.

items: Ratio distribution problems are frequently asked in SSC, Banking, and Railway competitive examinations.
Questions on compound ratios and converting fractional ratios to standard integer form appear consistently in quantitative aptitude sections.

blocks.content:
Example 6:

The ratio of boys to girls in a class is 3 : 2. If there are 30 boys, find the number of girls.

Solution:

3 : 2 = 30 : x

x = 20

Answer: 20



Example 7:

If a : b = 5 : 7 and b : c = 14 : 15, find a : c.

Solution:

a : b = 10 : 14

b : c = 14 : 15

a : c = 10 : 15 = 2 : 3

Answer: 2 : 3
